60bbcc2edf:
A character who can change forms to suit the situation. Make the most of each form: the nimble Mighty, the fast Dragon, the sharpshooting Pegasus and the powerful Titan.

Hold the normal attack button to charge an attack. Land it on an enemy to transform into the Rising state, which greatly boosts all your moves, so go for charged attacks whenever you get an opening.
e78a753fda:
A power fighter with mighty attacks. Can transform into three forms: Ground, Storm and Flame. Their speed and reach take some getting used to, but all of them hit hard, so you can keep pressing the attack.

Deal enough damage to enemies to unlock Burning Form, which dramatically raises attack power.
a031dac133:
A character with nimble normal attacks and incredibly strong support from Dragreder. Switch attack styles with Sword Vent, summon Dragreder with Advent to attack nearby enemies, and use each Vent to turn the battle in your favor.

Becoming Ryuki Survive also turns Dragreder into Dragranzer, unlocking even stronger moves.
4c475d381e:
A technical character with powerful but tricky special moves. Deal enough damage to enemies to unlock Accel Form.

In Accel Form you move at high speed for 10 seconds and your special moves change. Enemies are also greatly slowed during that time, so you can attack and overwhelm them one-sidedly.
fc44c21c96:
A close combat expert with airtight normal attacks and easy-to-use special moves.

Damaging enemies builds up AP, which you can spend on Rouse Cards to trigger a variety of special abilities.

Transforming into Jack Form improves gliding and aerial moves, letting you attack one-sidedly from the sky.
ef4213dc08:
A power type with extremely short reach but top-class firepower. Specializes in hit-and-run tactics: use mobile special moves and gliding to get in close, and get away fast when surrounded.

Deal enough damage to enemies to transform into Hibiki Kurenai, which boosts the power of all moves even further.
b4024ccdcc:
A character whose highlight is Clock Up, moving so fast the world around seems to slow down.

During Clock Up, keep hitting enemies to extend its duration. Keep your combos going to attack one-sidedly.

When your health is low, switching to Masked Form, which trades mobility for higher defense, is also a good tactic.
6bace17122:
An unusual character who fights by switching between six forms, each with its own personality. Every form specializes in offense, and their wide-reaching special moves let you overpower enemies.

Hold the normal attack button to Taunt. Hitting an enemy with an attack during a taunt greatly fills the finisher gauge.
b1632d172d:
A technical type with excellent speed and aerial attacks. Chain moves from the ground into the air and back down again. Gliding swiftly through the air is useful for both offense and defense, and great for extending combos.

Can transform into three forms: the fast, wide-reaching Garulu, Basshaa with its rapid-fire gun for one-sided attacks, and Dogga with its high-power hammer attacks.
e7048b3030:
An all-rounder with wide-reaching, excellent moves. Blast for long-range attacks, Slash to sweep the area quickly, and Final Attack Ride to blow away everything in a straight line ahead let him handle any situation.

With Kamen Ride he can transform into the selected Rider and use that Rider's special moves.
5ef2b86c83:
A technical character who can transform into CycloneJoker, good at fast melee, HeatMetal, strong in reach and power, and LunaTrigger, who can shoot at long range. Special moves add even more forms, for a total of nine.

Memory changes leave a small opening, but after the change the same special move has less recovery, so you can keep the combo going.
e29fa7f283:
A speed type who can fight at both close and long range.

Using the Fang Memory also raises attack speed and attack power.

Cut enemies to pieces up close, keep them in check from afar, or overwhelm them all at once with the Fang Memory. Many tactics are possible.
83b635076c:
A well-balanced character with easy-to-use normal attacks and special moves.

Damaging enemies earns medals, unlocking six combos: Gatakiriba with its strong clone attacks, Latorartar who overwhelms enemies with quick attacks, Sagohzo who blows away whole groups, Shauta who keeps enemies in check at mid range, Tajadol who can fight in the air, and Burakawani with its sturdy guard.
411251821b:
A character who switches between many Switches for dizzying attacks. Chain into Special Move 1 during normal attacks to switch Switches and branch into various attacks.

Can also transform into three States: Elek States, specialized in close combat, Fire States, with strong shooting attacks, and Magnet States, which mows down enemies with high power.
c9a3016141:
An easy-to-use character whose forceful normal attacks let him sweep enemies away as he advances.

Can transform into four styles: the forceful Flame, the technical Water, the defensive Land and Hurricane, which can glide.

Each style also has a special move that transforms into a Dragon form first, and after the move you can keep fighting in Dragon form for a while.
e42fd485fd:
An offensive type with long-reaching, high-power moves. Revving the Power Throttle builds the Tension Gauge, which raises attack power and strengthens special moves.

Deal enough damage to enemies to transform into Accel Booster, improving aerial combat.
6ca3cad740:
A relentless in-fighter with speed, forward momentum and easy-to-use normal attacks. His special moves are unique and all of them perform well.

Damaging enemies earns Cell Medals, which let him use several special weapons called the Birth CLAWs. Each weapon is a bit tricky, but used in the right situation they are extremely effective.
43ee764103:
A fast combo-based in-fighter with lots of hits. Excels at instantly getting deep inside the enemy's guard and mowing them down with a rush.

Move freely with Starlight Finish, which both attacks and evades, and pile on the combos.

With Meteor Galaxy he can also unleash special attacks, each with its own distinct style.
6a3abf6920:
A well-balanced character with nimble, long-reaching normal attacks. His attack power is high, and Strike Beast lets him cancel recovery into a charging attack.

Special moves activate each mantle's ability: Chameleo, which stops enemies for a while, Dolphi, which spends the finisher gauge to restore health, Buffa, which raises attack power, and Falco, which lets him glide through the air.
1af4a81f3a:
A very easy-to-use character whose normal attacks with the Daidaimaru and Musou Saber have long reach and many hits.

Fight by switching between Arms: the balanced Orange, Pine with reach and high power, and Ichigo with speed and projectiles.

Deal enough damage to enemies to unlock Jimber Lemon, which shoots arrows to wipe out enemies from long range.
09656a7203:
Has two Arms: Banana, with forward momentum and the long reach of the Banaspear, and Mango, with great power and attacks that hit all around.

Both Arms have moves that chain easily and are free of quirks, so you can overpower enemies right from the start.
b3ad629ed5:
A high-power type, a version of Decade even more focused on offense. His special moves have long recovery but huge power and range, scattering enemies in an instant.

He can use each Rider's special moves without Kamen Ride, so he can quickly adapt to any situation.
e8315f6c2e:
His special moves with the Sonic Arrow cover close to long range, so he can fight at any distance.

His Rider Cancel is a quick dash, letting him charge into enemy lines in an instant.

Master his special moves for each distance and many tactics open up.
76bbeb1d17:
A technical character who switches weapons as he triggers special moves.

He has six weapons in total: the orthodox Scorpion, the powerful grenade launcher Salamander, the high-power Destroyer, the wide-reaching Antares, the close-range Unicorn and the long-range Cerberus.

Using his finisher gives his shooting weapons unlimited ammo.
cfa7e92afa:
A character with both reach and speed who excels at close combat. His aerial movement is also excellent, and his Glide ability lets him leap into enemy lines from far away.

Making full use of Advent and Nasty Vent, which summon Dark Wing to attack, he can also press the attack safely from a distance.
9e875a6577:
A character with forceful normal combos and tricky special moves.

His special ability, Cursed Belt, is a double-edged sword that greatly boosts his special moves at the cost of the finisher gauge. It's hard to handle and puts the player's skill to the test.
f7c06b9bd4:
His normal attacks are mostly close-range strikes, while his special moves are mostly shots from the Garren Rouser. This two-sided style is his hallmark.

Damaging enemies builds up AP, which you can spend on Rouse Cards to trigger powerful special moves.

His strength is that by combining his special moves, he can keep attacking endlessly.
8bc2a4458b:
His normal attacks are fast martial arts with few openings. He fights mainly up close, but can also shoot with his Ongekikan, so he can fight at range too.

His special abilities Oniishi and Senpujin strengthen his normal attacks and special moves. Use them well to make up for his low attack power.

Using his finisher also fully charges Senpujin.
02a5938ef4:
Has two forms: Masked Form, with low mobility but strong attacks and shots, and Rider Form, with wide reach and many hits.

Masked Form has high defense, letting you overwhelm enemies without worrying about taking some damage.

In Rider Form, master Clock Up, moving so fast the world around seems to slow down, to make the most of his strengths.
ae9648082e:
A character whose strength is steady attacks with the long-reaching Zerogasher.

Altair Form has high mobility and a set of moves without quirks, making it easy to use. Vega Form is slow, but has high defense and powerful attacks.

There is no limit on form changes, so switch between them as the situation demands.
d2825bede5:
A character with two modes: Burst Mode, with overwhelming attack power, and Save Mode, which is weaker overall.

Burst Mode also has high mobility, but staying in it too long makes him overheat and leaves him defenseless. You can prevent overheating by switching to Save Mode, so using the two modes well is key.
f9c40fcf96:
A character with fast melee combos and powerful shooting special moves. His Rider Cancel, Invisible, makes him great at hit-and-run: get away from enemies and shoot.

His special ability Kamen Ride summons the selected Rider, who then performs their own unique attack.
946ec1f9b2:
A character specialized in close-range striking.

His special move Kick Combination lets him build unique combos that mix normal attacks and special moves.

Pulling off his special ability, his Catchphrase, spends the finisher gauge to raise his attack power and attack speed.
a50b8dd5a8:
A balanced character with Type Changes. In Type Speed, swapping Shift Cars changes how his special moves work, so he can adapt to any situation. Type Wild has less mobility but high attack power, and Type Technic has wide reach.

Type Dead Heat has very high attack power, but after a while it leaves him defenseless.
7ef9cb39d8:
A highly mobile character with strikes using the Zenrin Shooter and distinctive shot attacks.

Changing Signal Bikes with Signal Koukan changes how his special moves work.

Using Zuutto Mach raises his own speed, increasing his ability to control the battle.
c04fb36287:
A character who can change forms to suit the situation. Make the most of each form: the nimble Mighty, the fast Dragon, the sharpshooting Pegasus and the powerful Titan.

Hold the normal attack button to charge an attack. Land it on enemies enough times to unlock the Ultimate state, with phenomenal attack power.
1f8406d770:
A character with two styles: Fighting Style and Throwing Style.

As the names suggest, Fighting Style excels at close-range martial arts, while Throwing Style has a wealth of throws.

Combining special moves with style change attacks lets him pull off flowing combos.
abffca4aec:
A balanced character with standard close-range martial arts and charging special moves.

Damaging enemies fills the Double Typhoon Gauge, which he can spend to trigger various special moves.

He can also glide through the air with his Gliding Muffler, giving him great mobility.
967a149ef0:
A character who changes the shape of his special weapon, the Ridol, for different tactics.

Switch between the fast-hitting Ridol Whip, the standard Ridol Stick, the wide-reaching Ridol Rope and the long-reaching Long Pole to adapt to any situation.
ef404fa912:
A power fighter with powerful normal attacks and special moves using the power of electricity. Damaging enemies builds Electric Energy, and releasing it puts him in a Charged state that strengthens his attacks.

Releases can be stacked, raising the Charged state one level each time. At level three he becomes a character with astonishing attack power.
208b4653a3:
A speed fighter with the Five Hands, which change his special moves when swapped. Each Hand's special moves have strengths and weaknesses, so use them according to the situation.

When a ground special move ends, press the special move button again at the right time to follow up with a branch of that move. Chaining all four ground special moves also greatly strengthens the last move.
4b14dbca72:
Besides the standard RX, he can transform into two forms: Robo Rider, with high attack power and focused on shooting, and the fast and tricky Bio Rider.

As RX, the Sunriser Gauge fills over time. When the gauge is full, he can revive even if his health reaches 0, so you can fight without fear of failure.
441af7d1f3:
A character with easy-to-use sword attacks and plenty of special moves. Chain into Special Move 1 during normal attacks to unleash special moves borrowing the power of various heroes.

Use a hero's special move after defeating 100 enemies to raise various abilities for a while. The raised abilities depend on which hero's special move you use, so choose according to the situation.
3ea12aa026:
A power fighter who fights mainly with martial arts. Vital Charge, which stores energy in his belt, can be charged even while doing other actions.

When the energy is full, he can cancel ground damage recovery with King Stone Flash, and can make his fists burst into flame at any time.

Flaming fists strengthen normal attacks and special moves, so ignite them often.
288b7a9c7e:
As his nickname "Power No. 2" suggests, a power fighter with many mighty attacks. His special moves are simple and powerful, making him very easy to use.

After each special move, press the button again with good timing to greatly improve its attack performance. There's no downside, so go for it every time.
fc6595b961:
Many of his moves end in the air, and he has a wide variety of aerial moves, letting him move freely in all directions.

His special moves using the Condorer are all quirky, but used well they extend combos, so try combining them with various moves.
4529df05d0:
A character with Sailing Jump Mode, in which he floats in the air constantly. In this mode his special moves change and he moves as if flying.

He can cancel moves into a mode switch, so you can enjoy acrobatic action by going back and forth between the two modes.
cedf3560e6: Takeshi Hongo disguised as a Shocker Combatman. His actions are limited, so clearing missions with him takes considerable skill.
345e9be005:
A character with fast normal attacks and easy-to-use special moves. All of his special moves stop him in place, but they have excellent reach. Make up for his weak forward momentum with Rider Cancel.

Use a hero's special move after defeating 100 enemies to raise various abilities for a while. The raised abilities depend on which hero's special move you use, so choose according to the situation.
00ffdf351a:
A character with long-reaching normal attacks using the Sunglasslasher and easy-to-use special moves. His moves have excellent power and reach.

His special ability, Burning Toucon, boosts his own attack power, giving him overwhelming firepower for a while.
380f6d62fc:
A character with no openings: up close he mixes bare-handed strikes with the Shingou Axe, and at range he shoots with the Break Gunner.

His special move Across Breaker takes 3 seconds to prepare and has a time limit, but once ready, his attacks are incredibly strong.
5564523333: In Time Survival, clear a level (a row of missions) to earn a figure that powers up your Rider. Mind the time limit!
fd6a4f7329: Defeat Shocker Researchers in Story Mode to unlock new Time Survival levels. Don't let them get away!
a4d35aa324: In Time Survival, clear each level (a row of missions) within the time limit. If you run out of time while fighting, the mission fails.
6a4df25c59:
With the finisher gauge at least half full, press 

to unleash a powerful finisher. The finisher gauge fills when you attack enemies or pick up items.
f35c45a3d7: Use a finisher at full gauge, then use another before the gauge empties to become the even stronger Ultimate state.
39015cc35c: Fighting with your tag partner slowly raises the Voltage Gauge. Hit an enemy together (red hit effect) to raise it faster.
a9dacc3545: At 25%, 50% and 75% Voltage, your tag partner's bonuses activate. At 100%, use the Double Rider Finish.
7097b3a862:
+ / + / +

Call your tag partner to attack. It uses 10% of the Voltage Gauge, so call for help when you're in a pinch.
bf2915b18d: Equipping a figure gives you its parameters and skills. If you find a gold box during a mission, break it to get a figure.
d1e00414c1: Equipped figures level up as you fight, and higher levels give bigger bonuses. Always keep figures equipped!
14a16bf8cf: Some figures only work on the player, and some only on your tag partner. Check before you equip them.
28e17131bf: Some Riders' special moves branch when you mash or hold the button. Check them in Special Moves in the pause menu.
538077b705:
During an attack,  Rider Cancel

Cancels the recovery after an attack. Try finding your own ways to chain moves with Rider Cancel.
6aae5462eb: Guarding blocks enemy attacks and also resets the camera direction. When surrounded, guard and check what's around you.
8e8a55a0e1:
Lock on to a boss or certain enemies and the camera follows them automatically. Also useful when you lose sight of an enemy.

While locked on, use  up/down to choose a target.
737cb42e4b:
+ Rider Glide

Uses a little of the finisher gauge, but works even while you're being hit. Use it freely when you're in a pinch.
68e9787075:
When a Rider's health gets low, the finisher gauge starts filling gradually.

Fill the finisher gauge and turn the tables in one shot.
cdd3abb848:
Riding, while jumping off a ramp, 

The shockwave on landing, Attack Blast, blows enemies away. Steer so it hits groups of enemies.
f32428903e:
While riding a bike or the Tridoron, 

Slide Turn turns you around 180 degrees. Use it to get to the next destination quickly.
d81e94afe2:
While riding, hold  Wheelie

While riding,  Special Move

A wheelie accelerates sharply, and the Special Move dodges enemy attacks and mines.
46cda6ba22: At character select, you can spend Rider Souls to level up characters. Collect Rider Souls in missions and grow your favorite characters.
1a8b4d2079: Helicopters in missions go down in one hit if you ram them with a bike or the Tridoron. Use ramps to reach them.
48eca074d4: In Custom Soundtrack, make playlists to change the music in the game. Play your favorites to get pumped up!
